queries: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS margin_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average gives each telescope with a non-null bandwidth usage equal weight.
